column2: CPAO Special Seal Authority timeline — {{c1::21 days}} for {{c2::superannuation retirement}} vs {{c3::10 days}} for {{c4::death/family pension}} — source?
column3:
Rule: DoPPW OM 09.03.2021 + Rule 80(3) retirement track + Rule 76(8)(b) death track + Timeline OM 12.11.2024:

• Superannuation: AO → CPAO within 2 months of receipt of pension papers; CPAO issues Special Seal within 21 days of receipt of PPO (DoPPW timeline).

• Death/Family Pension: AO → CPAO within 1 month of receipt of family pension case; CPAO issues Special Seal within 10 days; PDA disburses within 15 days.

• TRAP: Retirement 21d, Death 10d — do not interchange.

Hinglish: Retirement me 21 din, mrityu me 10 din — CPAO ka seal.

Ref: Rule 80(2)(3)(4); Rule 76(8); DoPPW OM 3(6)/2021-P&PW(H)-7083 dt 09.03.2021; DoPPW Timeline OM dt 12.11.2024
